# OwnPay - Open-Source, Self-Hosted Payment Gateway

> OwnPay is an open-source, self-hosted payment gateway platform built on PHP 8.3. It supports 100+ payment gateways, multi-brand tenancy, white-label checkout, double-entry ledger, and plugin extensibility. Zero transaction fees, AGPL-3.0 licensed.

This file contains the complete documentation for OwnPay. Each section includes the page title, source URL, description, and full markdown content.

## Introduction

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/introduction.md

OwnPay is an open-source, self-hosted payment gateway platform. It provides a complete payment infrastructure with multi-brand support, white-label checkout, and extensive plugin system.

## Quick Start

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/quickstart.md

Deploy OwnPay and accept your first payment in 5 minutes. This guide covers installation, configuration, and processing your first test transaction.

## Installation

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/installation.md

Production deployment instructions for shared hosting, VPS, and Docker environments. Covers server requirements, database setup, and security configuration.

## How OwnPay Works

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/fundamentals/how-ownpay-works.md

End-to-end payment architecture overview. Understand the flow from customer checkout to settlement, including brand isolation and gateway routing.

## Brands & Multi-Tenancy

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/fundamentals/brands.md

Isolated merchant tenants with separate gateways, domains, branding, staff, and ledger. Each brand operates independently within the same OwnPay instance.

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/fundamentals/payment-flow.md

## Ledger & Accounting

Source: https://ownpay.org/docs/fundamentals/ledger.md

Double-entry bookkeeping system. Every transaction creates balanced ledger entries for accurate financial tracking and reconciliation.
